gridDNA: Central vertical stack of bold text blocks and horizontal pill-shaped CTAs, anchored by a prominent price block at the bottom, all overlaid on a vibrant gradient background with scattered, angled product cards providing visual texture and implied social proof.

zones.note: dynamic, vibrant gradient covering the entire canvas

zones.treatment: white text on rounded purple pill container
zones.note: first of two sequential call-to-action steps

zones.treatment: white text on rounded purple pill container
zones.note: second of two sequential call-to-action steps, wider than the first

zones.treatment: bold red/orange text on rounded white rectangle container

zones.position: scattered across canvas, top-left, top-right, mid-left, mid-right
zones.treatment: angled, semi-transparent product cards with brand logos and small text
zones.note: background elements providing implied social proof and visual interest

typeScale: headline ~30% of canvas height, offer ~10%, cta text ~6%, body ~4%
colourBlocking: full-bleed gradient background, white text for main content, distinct purple pills for CTAs, and a prominent white/red block for the offer.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the central text stack allows each element to stand out, particularly between the headline, CTAs, and the final offer, creating clear visual breaks.
eyePath: The eye is immediately drawn to the large, bold headline, then follows the sequential CTA pills, down to the supporting body text, and finally lands on the highly contrasted and prominent offer at the bottom.
whyItWins: The layout wins by using a bold, attention-grabbing headline, a clear sequential call-to-action, and a highly contrasted, prominent offer, all within a visually dynamic but uncluttered central stack.
